specName: Documentation completeness — every package ships its full documentation set
approach: Extend the existing spec-061 render seam rather than building a parallel docs system: help-header injection in renderHelpPhp, welcome-folder migration across the three hard-coded sites (loader/projection/descriptor), a pure deriveDocMemberStates as the single tier source of truth, a HISTORY proposal fed by the existing decision-audit record, a deterministic engine-side SVG chart renderer, and 12 warning-level keyboard-lint checks wired through a memoized studio hook (no new timer).

decisions.decision: Layout charts are deterministic SVG text, not PNG
decisions.why: Byte-identical output (FR-014) is trivial for a pure string emitter, and the managed-PR path submits only text VFS entries - binary PNG charts would be silently dropped from community submissions
decisions.rejected: Canvas-rasterized PNG (non-deterministic bytes, DOM-dependent) and a pure-TS PNG encoder (requires a glyph rasterizer)

decisions.decision: Doc lint checks take plain string/data input, wired via a memoized studio hook
decisions.why: keyboard-lint has no runtime invocation today and must stay contracts-only; the useTouchKeyDiagnostics memo precedent satisfies FR-019/D3 with no new timer, and string inputs validate exactly what will ship (members render at projection time, not in the VFS)
decisions.rejected: VFS-reading checks inside lintWithContext (would validate stale/absent content) and DOMParser for 11.5 (breaks node-testability)

decisions.decision: Source tier (FR-022) is a pure derivation, not a written-through store record
decisions.why: Tier is deterministically derivable from slices the store already holds; a single deriveDocMemberStates function cannot drift, while N writer-maintained update sites would silently lie to FR-020
decisions.rejected: A docProvenance map updated by every content-changing action

decisions.decision: Base documentation profile computed lazily from the already-fetched .kps manifest plus one welcome-probe fetch
decisions.why: The base browser discards the full tree listing and precomputing 1026 profiles is the cost the spec assumption warns about; the .kps answers membership and one probe answers stub-vs-full
decisions.rejected: A build-time facet-index field (deferred, the pure classifier can feed it later) and full-gallery classification

plan.summary: Plan complete: 13 resolved research decisions, data model, 4 contract files, quickstart; Constitution Check PASS on all nine articles; 7-phase story-ordered implementation sequence.

tasks.summary: 79 tasks in 10 phases: 1 setup, 3 foundational (contracts types + zod), US1 5, US2 13, US3 8, US4 8, US5 8, US6 8, US7 20, 5 polish; 29 parallelizable; one commit per phase on 076-documentation-completeness; MVP = US1 (help header) alone.
